title: ID0418446-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000687] Screen black
description: The charging station screen is black and unusable. The connectors are green. The LEDs on the grey box behind the screen are off. Could you please replace the screen?

Dear Team,
Customer reported issue of Screen Black.
We need to plan for the site intervention.
We need to check the FC14. If it is ON.
We need to check for the 24v and 0v on HMI.
Pls check if DP cable & USB are fine, We need to have spare to swap and check.
If 24v is absent,
We need to check for the following Highlighted Terminals.
Pls validate if the Display control board is fine, check if have burn marks, if so, we need to consider replacing the HMI.
If you need additional information, Feel free to reach out to NOC Team.
